words.enDefinition: the meal you eat in the middle of the day

examples.en: I usually have lunch at the dining hall between my morning classes.
examples.zh: 我通常在上午的课之间去食堂吃「午餐」。

examples.en: We could grab lunch at the food truck park near the library.
examples.zh: 我们可以去图书馆旁边的餐车广场吃「午饭」。

words.enDefinition: a small amount of food eaten between meals

examples.en: I always keep a snack in my backpack for long study sessions.
examples.zh: 我包里总会放一份「零食」，长时间学习时补充体力。

examples.en: Yogurt with granola is my go-to snack during exam week.
examples.zh: 酸奶配燕麦脆是我考试周最爱的「零食」。

words.enDefinition: an informal word for the evening meal in some families

examples.en: We usually have supper around six at my host family's place.
examples.zh: 在寄宿家庭，我们通常六点左右吃「晚饭」。

examples.en: Grandma kept supper warm for me even though I got home late.
examples.zh: 虽然我到家晚了，奶奶还是帮我留着「晚饭」。

words.enDefinition: a late-morning meal that combines breakfast and lunch

examples.en: Sunday brunch at that cafe near campus is our weekly tradition.
examples.zh: 周日在校园附近那家咖啡馆吃「早午餐」是我们的每周传统。

examples.en: We're doing brunch at eleven, so don't eat too much breakfast.
examples.zh: 我们十一点去吃「早午餐」，所以早餐别吃太饱。

words.enDefinition: the usual time when people eat a meal

examples.en: In my dorm, mealtime gets really crowded around six thirty.
examples.zh: 在我们宿舍楼，六点半左右的「用餐时间」特别挤。

examples.en: Try to keep regular mealtimes even when you're totally swamped with coursework.
examples.zh: 即使功课再忙，也要保持规律的「用餐时间」。

words.enDefinition: the free period at midday set aside for eating

examples.en: My lunch break is only thirty minutes between back-to-back classes.
examples.zh: 我连堂课之间只有三十分钟的「午休时间」。

examples.en: Let's grab coffee during your lunch break and catch up properly.
examples.zh: 趁你「午休」的时候我们去喝杯咖啡，好好聊聊。

words.enDefinition: an evening meal eaten together with family members

examples.en: Sunday family dinner is the one time everyone is home together.
examples.zh: 周日的「家庭晚餐」是全家人唯一都在家的时刻。

examples.en: My roommate skips family dinners because his parents live overseas.
examples.zh: 我室友从不参加「家庭晚餐」，因为他父母远在海外。

words.enDefinition: the normal pattern of eating morning, noon, and evening

examples.en: With my packed class schedule, I barely manage three meals a day.
examples.zh: 课程表排得太满，我几乎凑不齐「一日三餐」。

examples.en: My doctor told me to eat three meals a day, no skipping.
examples.zh: 医生让我好好吃「一日三餐」，不许再跳过任何一餐。

words.enDefinition: food eaten late at night, usually before bed

examples.en: Instant noodles are my go-to midnight snack during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周「深夜零食」的首选就是泡面。

examples.en: Don't expect me to join the all-nighter without a midnight snack.
examples.zh: 别指望我参加通宵学习还不带点「夜宵」。

words.enDefinition: a shared meal where each guest brings one dish

examples.en: Our study group is hosting a potluck before finals start.
examples.zh: 我们学习小组打算在期末前办一场「各带一菜的聚餐」。

examples.en: Sign up on the sheet so our potluck doesn't end up with five desserts.
examples.zh: 在表格上登记你想带的菜，免得这场「聚餐」最后全是甜点。

words.enDefinition: a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park

examples.en: The weather is perfect for a picnic by the lake this weekend.
examples.zh: 这周末天气正好，适合去湖边「野餐」。

examples.en: We spread our picnic out on the grass after morning lectures.
examples.zh: 上午的课结束后，我们在草地上铺开「野餐」。

words.enDefinition: a large special meal with plenty of good food

examples.en: Thanksgiving at my aunt's place is always a huge feast.
examples.zh: 在姑姑家过的感恩节总是一场「盛宴」。

examples.en: The dining hall put on a real feast for Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 食堂为农历新年准备了实实在在的一顿「大餐」。

words.enDefinition: a packaged frozen meal heated and eaten from its tray

examples.en: Living off TV dinners during midterms saved me so much time.
examples.zh: 期中期间靠「速冻盒装晚餐」过活，帮我省了不少时间。

examples.en: He heated a TV dinner while rewatching last night's game.
examples.zh: 他一边重看昨晚的比赛，一边热了一份「速冻晚餐」。

words.enDefinition: another serving of food after finishing the first one

examples.en: The roast was so good that everyone asked for a second helping.
examples.zh: 烤肉太好吃了，每个人都想「再来一份」。

examples.en: I was too full for a second helping, even though grandma insisted.
examples.zh: 虽然奶奶一直劝，我已经太饱了，实在没法「再来一份」。

words.enDefinition: the sleepy feeling right after eating a big meal

examples.en: I hit a food coma after the holiday dinner and napped for two hours.
examples.zh: 节日大餐后我立刻「饭气攻心」，睡了两个小时。

examples.en: Walk around campus after lunch to avoid the dreaded food coma.
examples.zh: 午饭后在校园里走一走，避免可怕的「饭后困倦」。

words.enDefinition: asks which dishes will be served for the evening meal

examples.en: Every day at five my roommate texts me asking what's for dinner.
examples.zh: 我室友每天下午五点都会发消息问我：「晚饭吃什么？」

examples.en: What's for dinner? I can smell something amazing from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 「晚饭吃什么？」我从厨房闻到一股特别香的味道。

words.enDefinition: feeling that you want or need to eat

examples.en: I skipped breakfast, so by noon I was really hungry.
examples.zh: 我没吃早餐，到中午已经非常「饿」了。

examples.en: Are you hungry enough to split a large pizza with me?
examples.zh: 你「饿」不饿？够饿的话我们分一大份披萨？

words.enDefinition: having eaten enough that you don't want more food

examples.en: No thanks, I'm full — I finished two helpings of pasta.
examples.zh: 不用了，我「吃饱了」，两份意面都下肚了。

examples.en: The portions here are huge; you'll be full after half of it.
examples.zh: 这家菜量特别大，吃到一半你就「饱」了。

words.enDefinition: extremely hungry, almost to the point of weakness

examples.en: After back-to-back labs, I walked into the apartment completely famished.
examples.zh: 连上两节实验课后，我进门时已经「饿坏了」。

examples.en: You look famished — let's eat something before your night class.
examples.zh: 看你「饿坏了」的样子，晚课前我们先吃点东西吧。

words.enDefinition: slightly hungry, wanting a small snack

examples.en: I get peckish around three, so I stash nuts in my desk drawer.
examples.zh: 我下午三点总会「有点饿」，所以在抽屉里藏了坚果。

examples.en: Feeling a little peckish? There's leftover pizza in the shared fridge.
examples.zh: 有点「饿」？公共冰箱里还有剩披萨。

words.enDefinition: very dry mouth because you need a drink

examples.en: Two lectures straight with no water bottle left me absolutely parched.
examples.zh: 连上两节课又没带水杯，我「口干舌燥」。

examples.en: After soccer practice I was so parched that I drank two sports drinks.
examples.zh: 足球训练后我「渴坏了」，一口气喝了两瓶运动饮料。

words.enDefinition: the natural desire to eat food

examples.en: Stress during finals week has completely killed my appetite lately.
examples.zh: 期末周的压力最近让我的「食欲」全没了。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread gave me a huge appetite.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味让我「胃口」大开。

words.enDefinition: a strong sudden desire for a specific food

examples.en: Late at night I always get a craving for fried chicken.
examples.zh: 深夜我总会「馋」炸鸡。

examples.en: My roommate gets cravings for spicy food right before every exam.
examples.zh: 我室友每到考试前就特别「馋」辣的。

words.enDefinition: a lasting liking for sweet foods and desserts

examples.en: I have a serious sweet tooth, so dessert tables are dangerous for me.
examples.zh: 我特别「爱吃甜食」，所以甜品区对我来说很危险。

examples.en: Everyone in my host family has a sweet tooth except the dad.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭里除了爸爸，人人「爱吃甜食」。

words.enDefinition: to drink something that stops you feeling thirsty

examples.en: Nothing quenches your thirst like iced water after a long run.
examples.zh: 长跑之后，没有什么比冰水更「解渴」的了。

examples.en: Sports drinks are designed to quench your thirst after long workouts.
examples.zh: 运动饮料专为长时间锻炼后「止渴」而设计。

words.enDefinition: smelling or looking so good you want to eat it

examples.en: The Friday curry at the dining hall smells absolutely mouth-watering.
examples.zh: 食堂周五的咖喱闻起来实在太「让人流口水」了。

examples.en: She posted a mouth-watering photo of her homemade lasagna online.
examples.zh: 她发了一张自制千层面的照片，看着就「让人流口水」。

words.enDefinition: to eat more food than your body needs

examples.en: I always overeat at buffets because everything looks so good.
examples.zh: 自助餐什么都好吃，我每次都「吃得过多」。

examples.en: Try not to overeat late at night; it ruins your sleep.
examples.zh: 深夜别「吃太多」，会影响睡眠。

words.enDefinition: bad-tempered or irritable because you are hungry

examples.en: Don't take it personally — he always gets hangry before dinner.
examples.zh: 别往心里去，他晚饭前总会「饿得发脾气」。

examples.en: I get hangry if I go more than five hours without eating.
examples.zh: 超过五个小时没吃东西，我就会「饿怒」。

words.enDefinition: to eat food slowly without real interest or appetite

examples.en: She just picked at her salad, too nervous to actually eat.
examples.zh: 她紧张得根本吃不下，只是「拨弄着」那份沙拉。

examples.en: He picked at his dinner all evening while worrying about the interview.
examples.zh: 他一晚上都在为面试发愁，晚餐只是「挑挑拣拣」没怎么吃。

words.enDefinition: to miss breakfast, lunch, or dinner on purpose

examples.en: I skip meals during finals week and then feel awful by evening.
examples.zh: 期末周我总是「不吃正餐」，到晚上就难受。

examples.en: Never skip a meal before a big exam; your brain needs fuel.
examples.zh: 大考前千万别「饿一顿」，大脑需要能量。

words.enDefinition: to eat something quickly without a big meal

examples.en: Let's grab a bite between lectures — there's a deli nearby.
examples.zh: 课间我们去「随便吃点」吧，附近有家熟食店。

examples.en: I only had time to grab a bite before my shift started.
examples.zh: 上班前我只来得及「随便吃了一口」。

words.enDefinition: to take small gentle bites of food

examples.en: She nibbled on crackers while reviewing her notes for hours.
examples.zh: 她一边连续几个小时复习笔记，一边「小口吃着」饼干。

examples.en: I nibbled at my toast because I was running late for the bus.
examples.zh: 因为要赶不上公交了，我只是「咬了几小口」吐司。

words.enDefinition: to chew food steadily and often noisily

examples.en: He munched on chips all the way through movie night.
examples.zh: 电影之夜他「嚼」了一晚上薯片。

examples.en: I was munching an apple while rushing to my nine a.m. lecture.
examples.zh: 我边走边「大口啃」苹果，赶着去上九点的课。

words.enDefinition: an amount of food or drink that fills the mouth

examples.en: Swallow first — don't answer my question with a full mouthful.
examples.zh: 先咽下去再说话，别「满口」东西就回答我。

examples.en: With each mouthful of hot soup, my sore throat felt better.
examples.zh: 每「喝一口」热汤，喉咙就舒服一些。

words.enDefinition: to have meals at home instead of going out

examples.en: We decided to eat in and split the cost of groceries.
examples.zh: 我们决定「在家吃」，分摊买菜钱。

examples.en: Eating in twice a week saves me around thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 每周「在家吃」两次，能省下大约三十美元。

words.enDefinition: someone who refuses many kinds of food

examples.en: My host family says their youngest son is a really picky eater.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭说他们家的小儿子很「挑食」。

examples.en: As a picky eater, I always check the menu before dinner plans.
examples.zh: 作为一个「挑食的人」，我答应饭局前一定会先看菜单。

words.enDefinition: food that makes you feel better when stressed or sad

examples.en: For me, instant noodles are the ultimate comfort food after exams.
examples.zh: 对我来说，考完试后的终极「疗愈食物」就是泡面。

examples.en: Her comfort food of choice during finals week is ice cream.
examples.zh: 期末周她选的「慰藉食物」是冰淇淋。

words.enDefinition: food that is tasty but high in fat and sugar

examples.en: I'm trying to cut back on junk food before beach season.
examples.zh: 夏天到之前，我正试着少碰「垃圾食品」。

examples.en: The vending machine downstairs is full of junk food and soda.
examples.zh: 楼下的自动售货机全是「垃圾食品」和汽水。

words.enDefinition: food prepared and served very quickly at chain restaurants

examples.en: We grabbed fast food on the road trip because everything was closed.
examples.zh: 公路旅行时店都关了，我们随便吃了点「快餐」。

examples.en: Eating fast food every day gets expensive and unhealthy really fast.
examples.zh: 天天吃「快餐」，既费钱又不健康。

words.enDefinition: a meal prepared at home from fresh ingredients

examples.en: After a month of dining hall food, I crave a home-cooked meal.
examples.zh: 吃了一个月食堂，我特别想念「家常菜」。

examples.en: My host mom makes the best home-cooked meals on weekends.
examples.zh: 寄宿妈妈周末做的「家常菜」最棒。

words.enDefinition: eating a healthy mix of different foods

examples.en: It's hard to keep a balanced diet when the dorm has no kitchen.
examples.zh: 宿舍没有厨房，很难坚持「均衡饮食」。

examples.en: My professor said a balanced diet really helps your concentration.
examples.zh: 教授说「均衡饮食」有助于集中注意力。

words.enDefinition: following a controlled eating plan to lose weight

examples.en: I'm on a diet until the wedding in June, so no dessert.
examples.zh: 六月婚礼前我都在「节食」，甜点就免了。

examples.en: She's on a diet that cuts out late-night snacks completely.
examples.zh: 她正在「节食」，完全戒掉了深夜零食。

words.enDefinition: choosing nutritious food as a daily habit

examples.en: Healthy eating on a student budget starts with rice, eggs, and beans.
examples.zh: 学生预算下的「健康饮食」可以从米饭、鸡蛋和豆类做起。

examples.en: Our dorm floor started a healthy eating challenge this month.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼层这个月开启了「健康饮食」挑战。

words.enDefinition: to eat small amounts of food between meals

examples.en: I snack on almonds while reading in the library for hours.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆一坐几个小时，期间「拿杏仁当零食」吃。

examples.en: Don't snack on chips right before dinner, or you won't be hungry.
examples.zh: 晚饭前别「拿薯片当零食」吃，不然正餐就吃不下了。

words.enDefinition: to eat food very quickly and greedily

examples.en: I wolfed down a sandwich before sprinting to my afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 我「狼吞虎咽」地塞了个三明治，就冲去上下午的研讨课。

examples.en: Don't wolf down your lunch; the study group meets in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 别「狼吞虎咽」，学习小组二十分钟后就开始了。

words.enDefinition: to eat something quickly and eagerly

examples.en: My roommates gobbled up the dumplings I brought back from home.
examples.zh: 我从家里带的饺子，室友们「一口气吃光了」。

examples.en: He gobbled up his breakfast and ran to catch the early bus.
examples.zh: 他「三口两口」吃完早饭就赶早班车去了。

words.enDefinition: to eat a meal, especially with enthusiasm

examples.en: The pizza just got here, so grab a plate and chow down.
examples.zh: 披萨刚送到，拿个盘子「开吃」吧。

examples.en: We chowed down on burgers after moving boxes all day long.
examples.zh: 搬了一整天箱子之后，我们「大快朵颐」地吃了顿汉堡。

words.enDefinition: to start eating a meal eagerly

examples.en: Dinner's finally ready, so dig in before it gets completely cold.
examples.zh: 晚饭终于好了，趁没凉赶紧「开动」。

examples.en: My roommate said we could dig in once everyone had a place to sit.
examples.zh: 室友说，等每个人都有座位，我们就可以「开吃」。

words.enDefinition: to eat all the food you have been given

examples.en: Eat up, everyone — I made extra portions on purpose tonight.
examples.zh: 大家把饭「吃干净」，我今晚特意多做了几份。

examples.en: My grandma never let us leave the table until we ate up.
examples.zh: 奶奶以前总要我们「吃干净」了才让离开饭桌。

words.enDefinition: to swallow food with the help of a drink

examples.en: I washed down the salty fries with a large soda.
examples.zh: 我用一大杯汽水「送下」了那些咸薯条。

examples.en: These dry crackers need something to wash them down with.
examples.zh: 这饼干太干了，得就着点什么「咽下去」。

collocations: need something to wash it down

words.enDefinition: to warm cooked food again before eating

examples.en: You can reheat the pizza in the microwave for thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 把披萨放进微波炉「加热」三十秒就行。

examples.en: Reheat the leftover rice with a splash of water to keep it soft.
examples.zh: 「加热」剩饭时加一点点水，米饭才会保持松软。

words.enDefinition: to finish all the food served to you

examples.en: I always clean my plate because my host mom cooks so well.
examples.zh: 寄宿妈妈手艺太好，我每次都「光盘」。

examples.en: You don't have to clean your plate here; leftovers can be boxed.
examples.zh: 在这儿不必硬「吃光盘子」，剩菜可以打包。

words.enDefinition: to eat very large amounts of food

examples.en: My swimmer roommate eats like a horse after every morning practice.
examples.zh: 我那个游泳队的室友每次早训后「饭量大得惊人」。

examples.en: My little host brother eats like a horse but stays really skinny.
examples.zh: 我家寄宿的弟弟「特别能吃」，却依然很瘦。

collocations: eat like a horse after practice

words.enDefinition: edible food that gets thrown away uneaten

examples.en: The dining hall started publicly tracking food waste last semester.
examples.zh: 食堂上学期开始公开统计「食物浪费」。

examples.en: Taking smaller portions cuts down on food waste at the buffet.
examples.zh: 自助餐少拿一点，就能减少「食物浪费」。

words.enDefinition: to eat small or low-fat amounts of food

examples.en: I'm eating light today after that huge holiday brunch yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天假日晚餐吃太多了，今天我要「吃得清淡」些。

examples.en: Let's eat light tonight since we're having a big barbecue tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天要烧烤大吃一顿，今晚我们「吃清淡点」。

words.enDefinition: water that comes from the kitchen faucet

examples.en: In this city, tap water is safe to drink straight from the faucet.
examples.zh: 这座城市的「自来水」可以直接喝。

examples.en: Can I just get tap water? I don't need bottled.
examples.zh: 我可以要「自来水」吗？不用瓶装水。

words.enDefinition: drinking water sold in sealed bottles

examples.en: I always keep bottled water in my backpack for long lectures.
examples.zh: 我包里总备着「瓶装水」，上课长时间听讲用。

examples.en: Bottled water costs more here than soda, which seems backwards.
examples.zh: 这儿「瓶装水」比汽水还贵，感觉本末倒置。

words.enDefinition: water served with ice to keep it very cold

examples.en: American restaurants automatically bring everyone ice water with their meals.
examples.zh: 美国餐厅都会自动给每位客人上「冰水」。

examples.en: A big glass of ice water fixed my headache after the gym.
examples.zh: 健身后一大杯「冰水」治好了我的头痛。

words.enDefinition: sweet fizzy drink, such as cola or lemon-lime

examples.en: I gave up soda for a month and saved so much money.
examples.zh: 我戒了一个月「汽水」，省下不少钱。

examples.en: Do you want ice and lemon in your soda or not?
examples.zh: 你的「汽水」要不要加冰和柠檬？

words.enDefinition: a non-alcoholic cold drink, usually sweet and fizzy

examples.en: The meal deal lets you pick any soft drink you like.
examples.zh: 套餐可以任选一款「软饮料」。

examples.en: I mostly drink water now, but I used to live on soft drinks.
examples.zh: 我现在主要喝水，以前可是靠「软饮料」过活的。

collocations: a soft drink with the meal

words.enDefinition: soda with artificial sweetener instead of sugar

examples.en: I switched to diet soda to cut sugar out of my routine.
examples.zh: 为了减少糖分摄入，我改喝「无糖汽水」了。

examples.en: Does the vending machine stock diet soda or only the regular kind?
examples.zh: 自动售货机有「无糖汽水」吗？还是只有普通款？

words.enDefinition: a sweet cold drink made from lemons

examples.en: Fresh lemonade from the farmers market is my favorite summer treat.
examples.zh: 农贸市场买的鲜「柠檬水」是我夏天的最爱。

examples.en: We sold lemonade on the quad to raise money for our club.
examples.zh: 我们在校园广场卖「柠檬水」给社团筹款。

words.enDefinition: a thick blended drink of fruit, yogurt, or juice

examples.en: I make a banana smoothie before my morning gym sessions.
examples.zh: 早晨健身前我会打一杯香蕉「果昔」。

examples.en: That juice bar near campus charges eight dollars for one smoothie.
examples.zh: 校园附近那家饮品店一杯「冰沙」就要八美元。

words.enDefinition: a cold creamy drink blended from milk and ice cream

examples.en: We split a chocolate milkshake after the basketball game ended.
examples.zh: 篮球赛结束后我们合喝了一杯巧克力「奶昔」。

examples.en: This diner's vanilla milkshake is legendary among the freshmen here.
examples.zh: 这家小餐馆的香草「奶昔」在新生中名气很大。

words.enDefinition: cold tea served over ice, often sweetened

examples.en: Southern-style iced tea is sweeter than anything I drank back home.
examples.zh: 南方风味的「冰茶」比我在国内喝过的任何饮料都甜。

examples.en: A tall glass of unsweetened iced tea, please, with extra lemon.
examples.zh: 请给我一大杯不加糖的「冰茶」，多加柠檬。

words.enDefinition: a warm sweet drink made from cocoa and milk

examples.en: Nothing beats hot chocolate after shoveling snow outside the dorm.
examples.zh: 在宿舍外铲完雪，来杯「热巧克力」再好不过。

examples.en: The cafe tops its hot chocolate with whipped cream and marshmallows.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡馆的「热可可」上铺满鲜奶油和棉花糖。

words.enDefinition: a sweet milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls

examples.en: Let's get bubble tea after our last final ends on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五最后一场期末考结束后，我们去喝「珍珠奶茶」吧。

examples.en: She orders her bubble tea with half sugar and less ice.
examples.zh: 她点「奶茶」都选半糖少冰。

words.enDefinition: a light tea made from unfermented leaves

examples.en: I brew green tea instead of coffee when I'm feeling anxious.
examples.zh: 焦虑的时候我泡「绿茶」，不喝咖啡。

examples.en: The dining hall started serving hot green tea at dinner.
examples.zh: 食堂晚餐开始供应热「绿茶」了。

words.enDefinition: coffee served chilled over ice

examples.en: An iced coffee gets me through my eight a.m. lecture.
examples.zh: 一杯「冰咖啡」能撑过早上八点的课。

examples.en: He orders the same large iced coffee every single morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上都点同样的大杯「冰咖啡」。

words.enDefinition: a caffeinated drink marketed for quick energy

examples.en: Two energy drinks before the all-nighter wrecked my sleep schedule.
examples.zh: 通宵复习前灌了两罐「能量饮料」，把睡眠彻底搞乱了。

examples.en: The gym actually advises against energy drinks before your workouts.
examples.zh: 健身房其实不建议训练前喝「能量饮料」。

words.enDefinition: a flavored drink that replaces salts after exercise

examples.en: Coach hands out sports drinks after every long practice session.
examples.zh: 每次大强度训练后教练都会发「运动饮料」。

examples.en: For a one-hour gym session, water beats any sports drink.
examples.zh: 一小时以内的健身，白水比任何「运动饮料」都好。

collocations: water instead of a sports drink

words.enDefinition: a drink mixed from protein powder, usually after workouts

examples.en: He downs a protein shake right after lifting weights at the gym.
examples.zh: 他在健身房练完力量马上喝一杯「蛋白粉奶昔」。

examples.en: I blend my protein shake with banana and a spoon of peanut butter.
examples.zh: 我会在「蛋白奶昔」里加香蕉和一勺花生酱一起打。

words.enDefinition: coffee with most of the caffeine removed

examples.en: Evening decaf lets me join coffee chats without losing any sleep.
examples.zh: 晚上喝「无咖啡因咖啡」，既能参加咖啡社交又不怕失眠。

examples.en: Can I get this latte made with decaf instead of regular?
examples.zh: 这杯拿铁可以换成「低咖啡因」的吗？

words.enDefinition: the stimulant found naturally in coffee and tea

examples.en: I cut caffeine after three p.m. and started sleeping much better.
examples.zh: 我下午三点后不再摄入「咖啡因」，睡眠明显变好。

examples.en: This energy drink has more caffeine than two cups of coffee.
examples.zh: 这罐「能量饮料」的咖啡因比两杯咖啡还多。

words.enDefinition: to drink all of something quickly in big gulps

examples.en: He chugged his whole water bottle and ran back onto the field.
examples.zh: 他「猛灌」了一整瓶水，又跑回场上。

examples.en: Never chug an energy drink right before an exam starts.
examples.zh: 考试开始前千万别「猛灌」能量饮料。

words.enDefinition: a thin tube used for drinking cold drinks

examples.en: The boba shop near campus uses paper straws now instead of plastic.
examples.zh: 校园附近的奶茶店现在改用纸质「吸管」了。

examples.en: Can I get a straw for this iced coffee, please?
examples.zh: 这杯冰咖啡能给我一根「吸管」吗？

words.enDefinition: a small frozen block of water for cooling drinks

examples.en: Drop a few ice cubes in and the tea cools instantly.
examples.zh: 丢几块「冰块」进去，茶立刻就凉了。

examples.en: The shared freezer never has ice cubes when I actually need them.
examples.zh: 公共冰箱总是在我需要「冰块」的时候一块都没有。

words.enDefinition: to keep drinking enough water during the day

examples.en: Drink water regularly — you need to stay hydrated in this heat.
examples.zh: 天这么热，要常喝水「保持水分」。

examples.en: The trainer reminded us to stay hydrated during two-a-day practices.
examples.zh: 教练提醒我们一天两练期间要「补充水分」。

words.enDefinition: a milk-like drink made from soybeans

examples.en: I add soy milk to my latte because dairy upsets my stomach.
examples.zh: 我拿铁里加「豆奶」，因为乳制品让肠胃不舒服。

examples.en: The cafe near campus charges nothing extra for swapping in soy milk.
examples.zh: 校园附近这家咖啡馆换「豆奶」不加钱。

words.enDefinition: a plant-based milk substitute made from almonds

examples.en: Almond milk froths surprisingly well for homemade lattes on weekends.
examples.zh: 「杏仁奶」打奶泡的效果出奇地好，适合周末自制拿铁。

examples.en: I stock almond milk in the dorm fridge just for my cereal.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍小冰箱里囤了「杏仁奶」，专门泡麦片用。

words.enDefinition: a mat placed under plates to protect the table

examples.en: We set the table with placemats before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到之前，我们铺好「餐垫」摆好了桌子。

examples.en: A plastic placemat makes cleanup so much easier after spaghetti night.
examples.zh: 意面夜之后，塑料「餐垫」让收拾省事多了。

words.enDefinition: a flat board for carrying plates, cups, and food

examples.en: At the dining hall, you load everything onto one tray.
examples.zh: 在食堂，所有东西都装在一个「托盘」上。

examples.en: Carry your tray to the return rack when you finish eating.
examples.zh: 吃完把「托盘」放到回收架上。

words.enDefinition: the knives, forks, and spoons used for eating

examples.en: The dorm kitchen drawer is always out of clean silverware.
examples.zh: 宿舍厨房抽屉里永远找不到干净的「刀叉餐具」。

examples.en: Please rinse your silverware before putting it into the dishwasher.
examples.zh: 「餐具」请先冲一下再放进洗碗机。

words.enDefinition: the table where the family eats its meals

examples.en: Phones stay off the dinner table in my host family's house.
examples.zh: 在寄宿家庭，手机不许上「餐桌」。

examples.en: We gathered around the dinner table to share stories from the week.
examples.zh: 我们围坐在「饭桌」旁，分享这一周的见闻。

words.enDefinition: a small pointed stick for cleaning between teeth

examples.en: There's a jar of toothpicks by the register at that diner.
examples.zh: 那家小餐馆收银台边放着一罐「牙签」。

examples.en: Use a toothpick for the spinach stuck between your teeth.
examples.zh: 用「牙签」把塞在牙缝里的菠菜弄出来。

words.enDefinition: brand-name plastic containers for storing leftovers

examples.en: Pack the extra pasta in tupperware for tomorrow's lunch break.
examples.zh: 把多余的意面装进「保鲜盒」，明天午休时吃。

examples.en: Every shelf of our shared fridge is crammed with tupperware boxes.
examples.zh: 公共冰箱每一层都塞满了「塑料保鲜盒」。

words.enDefinition: a disposable plate made of thick paper

examples.en: For the dorm party, we bought three sleeves of paper plates.
examples.zh: 宿舍派对我们买了三沓「纸盘子」。

examples.en: Using paper plates means nobody fights over dish duty tonight.
examples.zh: 用「纸盘」的话，今晚就没人抢着洗碗了。

words.enDefinition: an insulated box that keeps food and drinks cold

examples.en: We packed the cooler with drinks for the beach picnic tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们往「冰桶」里装满饮料，准备明天的海滩野餐。

examples.en: Keep the cooler in the shade so the ice lasts longer.
examples.zh: 把「保温冰盒」放在阴凉处，冰才化得慢。

words.enDefinition: a plastic mold for freezing water into cubes

examples.en: Someone left our ice tray empty again in the shared freezer.
examples.zh: 公共冰箱的「冰块盒」又被人用空了，一直没人重新装水。

examples.en: Fill the ice tray after you take the last cube out.
examples.zh: 取走最后一块冰之后，请把「制冰格」重新装满。

words.enDefinition: a small tool for opening metal food cans

examples.en: Does anyone in this dorm actually own a proper can opener?
examples.zh: 这个宿舍里到底有谁有正经的「开罐器」吗？

examples.en: I bought a manual can opener because electric ones take up space.
examples.zh: 我买了手动「开罐器」，电动的太占地方。

words.enDefinition: a tool that pries caps off glass bottles

examples.en: Our bottle opener is magnetic and sticks to the fridge door.
examples.zh: 我们的「开瓶器」带磁吸，直接贴在冰箱门上。

examples.en: Someone always loses the bottle opener right before game night starts.
examples.zh: 每次游戏之夜开始前，「开瓶器」总会莫名其妙消失。

words.enDefinition: able to be heated in a microwave without damage

examples.en: Check that the container is microwave-safe before you reheat the soup.
examples.zh: 热汤之前，先确认容器是「可微波加热」的。

examples.en: That plastic box melted because it wasn't microwave-safe at all.
examples.zh: 那个塑料盒化了，因为它根本「不能进微波炉」。

words.enDefinition: able to be washed in a dishwasher without damage

examples.en: Most of our mugs are dishwasher-safe except the wooden-handled one.
examples.zh: 我们的马克杯大多「可用洗碗机洗」，只有木柄那只要手洗。

examples.en: Nonstick pans usually aren't dishwasher-safe, so you should wash them by hand.
examples.zh: 不粘锅一般「不能进洗碗机」，要手洗。

words.enDefinition: a woven basket that carries food for outdoor meals

examples.en: She packed the picnic basket with sandwiches and homemade lemonade.
examples.zh: 她往「野餐篮」里装了三明治和自制柠檬水。

examples.en: The checkered picnic basket was a graduation gift from my aunt.
examples.zh: 那只格子「野餐篮」是姑姑送我的毕业礼物。

words.enDefinition: a thick glove for handling hot dishes from the oven

examples.en: Use the oven mitt when you pull the hot dish out.
examples.zh: 把热菜端出来时要戴上「隔热手套」。

examples.en: There's only one oven mitt left in our shared dorm kitchen.
examples.zh: 宿舍公共厨房里只剩一只「烤箱手套」了。

words.enDefinition: a small appliance that browns sliced bread

examples.en: The shared toaster in our kitchen seriously needs a good clean.
examples.zh: 公共厨房的「烤面包机」真该好好清理一下了。

examples.en: Our toaster has a bagel setting for thicker, chewier slices.
examples.zh: 我们的「烤面包机」有贝果模式，可以烤厚而有嚼劲的面包片。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that mixes food and liquids smoothly

examples.en: I use the blender every morning for quick fruit smoothies.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都用「搅拌机」打快速的水果奶昔。

examples.en: Someone left the blender unwashed with smoothie still inside it.
examples.zh: 有人用完「料理机」没洗，里面还留着果昔。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that steams rice automatically

examples.en: A rice cooker is the first appliance every Chinese student buys here.
examples.zh: 「电饭煲」是中国留学生到这里的第一件采购。

examples.en: The rice cooker switches to keep-warm mode automatically when it finishes.
examples.zh: 「电饭煲」煮好后会自动跳到保温模式。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that boils water quickly for tea

examples.en: My electric kettle boils enough water for tea in three minutes.
examples.zh: 我的「电热水壶」三分钟就能烧开泡茶的水。

examples.en: Dorm rules ban hot plates but allow a small electric kettle.
examples.zh: 宿舍禁用电磁炉，但允许用小「电热水壶」。

words.enDefinition: a counter appliance that crisps food with hot air

examples.en: The air fryer reheats leftover pizza better than the microwave does.
examples.zh: 用「空气炸锅」热剩披萨比微波炉效果好。

examples.en: Our whole floor shares one air fryer in the common room.
examples.zh: 我们整层楼共用公共休息室里的一台「空气炸锅」。

collocations: crisp up fries in the air fryer

words.enDefinition: a machine that brews drip coffee at home

examples.en: Our coffee maker runs on a timer, so breakfast feels civilized.
examples.zh: 我们的「咖啡机」定时启动，早餐顿时有了仪式感。

examples.en: Descale the coffee maker once a month or it slows down.
examples.zh: 「咖啡机」每月要除一次垢，不然水流会变慢。

words.enDefinition: a person who eats no animal products at all

examples.en: As a vegan, she checks every label for hidden milk powder.
examples.zh: 作为「纯素食者」，她会检查每个标签里有没有隐藏的奶粉。

examples.en: The dining hall added a vegan station this semester, thankfully.
examples.zh: 谢天谢地，食堂这学期新增了「纯素」餐台。

words.enDefinition: a vegetarian who also eats fish and seafood

examples.en: I'm pescatarian, so I skip the chicken but take the salmon.
examples.zh: 我是「鱼素者」，不吃鸡肉但会拿三文鱼。

examples.en: Being pescatarian makes the campus menu much easier to navigate.
examples.zh: 当个「鱼素食者」，校园菜单就好选多了。

words.enDefinition: unable to digest milk sugar without discomfort

examples.en: I'm lactose intolerant, so I ask for soy milk in every latte.
examples.zh: 我「乳糖不耐受」，所以每杯拿铁都换豆奶。

examples.en: Most adults in my family are lactose intolerant — it's genetic.
examples.zh: 我家大多数长辈都「乳糖不耐受」，是遗传的。

words.enDefinition: made without wheat, barley, or rye proteins

examples.en: The campus bakery sells gluten-free muffins right by the register.
examples.zh: 校园面包房就在收银台边卖「无麸质」玛芬。

examples.en: My roommate went gluten-free after her doctor recommended the change.
examples.zh: 听了医生建议后，我室友开始吃「无麸质」饮食。

words.enDefinition: made without milk, butter, cheese, or cream

examples.en: The coffee shop carries dairy-free oat milk at no extra charge.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡店免费提供「无奶」的燕麦奶。

examples.en: Ask about dairy-free toppings if cheese always upsets your stomach.
examples.zh: 如果吃芝士总是肠胃不舒服，可以问问「不含乳制品」的配料。

words.enDefinition: made mostly or entirely from plant ingredients

examples.en: Plant-based burgers are now stocked next to the regular beef patties.
examples.zh: 「植物基」汉堡现在就摆在普通牛肉饼旁边卖。

examples.en: I follow a mostly plant-based diet during the busy school week.
examples.zh: 上学日我基本坚持「以植物为主」的饮食。

words.enDefinition: a bad immune reaction to a particular food

examples.en: Always tell the server about your food allergy before ordering anything.
examples.zh: 点餐前一定要告知服务员你的「食物过敏」。

examples.en: Because of his food allergy, our study snacks are strictly nut-free.
examples.zh: 因为他的「食物过敏」，学习小组的零食严格无坚果。

words.enDefinition: to track the energy value of everything you eat

examples.en: I count calories with an app during my training season.
examples.zh: 备赛期间我用软件「计算卡路里」。

examples.en: Counting calories made me anxious, so I stopped after a month.
examples.zh: 「数卡路里」让我很焦虑，一个月后就放弃了。

words.enDefinition: starchy and sugary foods that give quick energy

examples.en: I load up on carbs the night before a long run.
examples.zh: 长跑前一晚我会多补「碳水」。

examples.en: Cutting carbs completely is just not sustainable for most students.
examples.zh: 对大多数学生来说，完全断「碳水」是撑不住的。

words.enDefinition: made with no added sugar at all

examples.en: I keep sugar-free gum in my bag for long library days.
examples.zh: 我包里备着「无糖」口香糖，泡图书馆的日子用。

examples.en: These sugar-free cookies still taste surprisingly sweet to me somehow.
examples.zh: 这些「无糖」饼干吃起来不知怎么还是挺甜的。

words.enDefinition: containing much less fat than the regular version

examples.en: I buy low-fat yogurt for my post-gym snacks every week.
examples.zh: 我每周都买「低脂」酸奶当健身后的加餐。

examples.en: The dining hall labels every low-fat option really clearly now.
examples.zh: 食堂现在把每个「低脂」选项都标得很清楚。

words.enDefinition: limiting how much food you eat at one time

examples.en: Using smaller plates makes portion control much easier at home.
examples.zh: 用小盘子在家「控制食量」容易多了。

examples.en: The meal planning app taught me the basics of portion control.
examples.zh: 那个饮食计划软件教会了我基础的「分量控制」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of food one package considers a portion

examples.en: Check the serving size before assuming the whole bag is one portion.
examples.zh: 先看「每份含量」，别以为一整袋就是一份。

examples.en: The serving size listed on this ramen pack is only half the package.
examples.zh: 这个泡面标注的「每份含量」居然只有半包。

collocations: the serving size on the label

words.enDefinition: the panel showing calories and nutrients on packaging

examples.en: Read the nutrition label before buying granola bars in bulk.
examples.zh: 整箱买燕麦棒之前，先看看「营养成分表」。

examples.en: The nutrition label says one bowl has twelve grams of sugar.
examples.zh: 「营养标签」显示一碗含十二克糖。

collocations: the nutrition label on the back

words.enDefinition: a regular way that someone chooses and eats food

examples.en: Living with three roommates has completely changed my eating habits.
examples.zh: 和三个室友同住彻底改变了我的「饮食习惯」。

examples.en: Late-night study sessions built some terrible eating habits last year.
examples.zh: 深夜自习让我去年养成了不少糟糕的「饮食习惯」。

words.enDefinition: to return to get another serving of food

examples.en: The pasta was so good that everyone went back for seconds.
examples.zh: 意面太好吃，大家都「回去再添了一份」。

examples.en: Go back for seconds before the dining hall closes at eight.
examples.zh: 趁食堂八点才关门，快去「再添一份」。

collocations: too full to go back for seconds

words.enDefinition: cooking several meals ahead for a busy week

examples.en: Sunday meal prep saves me during my twelve-hour campus days.
examples.zh: 周日的「提前备餐」救了我那些十二小时的校园日。

examples.en: We do meal prep together on Sundays and split the grocery bill.
examples.zh: 我们周日一起「备餐」，然后分摊菜钱。

words.enDefinition: any drink, especially one served at an event

examples.en: The club meeting provides free beverages and pizza every Thursday.
examples.zh: 社团会议每周四提供免费「饮品」和披萨。

examples.en: Please bring your own beverage to the evening study hall.
examples.zh: 晚间自习室请自带「饮品」。

words.enDefinition: a cupboard or small room where food is stored

examples.en: Our pantry is stacked with instant noodles and canned beans.
examples.zh: 我们的「食品储藏柜」堆满了泡面和罐装豆子。

examples.en: Restock the shared pantry before someone raids it at midnight.
examples.zh: 趁还没人在深夜扫荡，先把公共「储藏柜」补满。

words.enDefinition: in reasonable amounts, without excess

examples.en: Bubble tea is fine in moderation — just not three times a day.
examples.zh: 奶茶「适量」喝没问题，只是一天别喝三杯。

examples.en: Snacks are okay in moderation, but don't replace real meals.
examples.zh: 零食「适量」吃没问题，但不能拿它代替正餐。

words.enDefinition: to prepare food at home to eat later at school

examples.en: I pack a lunch every night to avoid the dining hall lines.
examples.zh: 我每晚都「带饭」，免得在食堂排长队。

examples.en: Packing a lunch saves me at least fifty dollars a month.
examples.zh: 「自带午饭」每月至少帮我省五十美元。

collocations: pack a lunch the night before
save money by packing a lunch

words.enDefinition: a social evening where guests share a cooked meal

examples.en: My host family threw a dinner party for the new neighbors.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭为新邻居们办了一场「晚餐聚会」。

examples.en: We're hosting a small dinner party before everyone leaves for break.
examples.zh: 假期大家各奔东西之前，我们办一场小型「晚宴聚会」。

collocations: invite someone to a dinner party

words.enDefinition: a short rest during work or study for coffee

examples.en: Let's take a coffee break after finishing this forty-page chapter.
examples.zh: 啃完这四十页书，我们先来个「咖啡休息时间」吧。

examples.en: The ten o'clock coffee break is sacred in our research lab.
examples.zh: 我们实验室里十点的「咖啡休息」雷打不动。

words.enDefinition: a person who loves trying interesting new food

examples.en: My roommate is such a foodie that she rates every dining hall.
examples.zh: 我室友是个十足的「吃货」，连食堂都要打分。

examples.en: As a self-declared foodie, I plan trips around local food markets.
examples.zh: 作为自封的「美食爱好者」，我旅行都是围绕当地市场规划的。
